title: Build the Profile form
head: The final evidence commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies the tested code.

github_recheck.parent_ci: All active current-head checks passed; conditional jobs skipped.
github_recheck.base_decision: Continue corrected, unmerged D28 in a dedicated worktree; owner main preserved. No standalone-main compatibility claim.

source_pins.A20: Existing settings user-profile owner, compared with F23 canonical contract; no second store.

ownership: src/util/model-exec-env.ts: classify the F23 non-secret feature setting used by the proof

design_reference.inspection: Native Profile and UI33 Profile verification visually inspected in Chrome.
design_reference.limits: Not a pixel diff or full UI35 export. Sign-in sample identity intentionally not copied into canonical context.

host_requirements: Authenticated scope-bound transport and write permission; retire controller on logout, account/transport or permission replacement.
Same guardProfileNavigation port at shell and Profile; other routing calls controller.navigateAway and honors cancellation.
Live capability, scope and source must match. Verify combined production navigation and authenticated persistence before enabling.

implementation: Six native fields mapped via F23 explicit contract; full name unavailable and account-owned, five assistant-context fields editable.
44px fields, 96px context areas, multiline legacy Role retained, reserved validation/status and Save/Saved/Retry width; stable secondary width and wrapped narrow actions.
Changed-field-only revision-bound PATCH, then acknowledgment plus fresh matching readback.
Dirty polls pin draft baseline; new edits during save survive. Stale reads retain drafts but block writes.
Explicit unknown-save retry reconciles only unchanged baseline or exact attempted values; corrections conflict, no automatic replay.
Cancel/discard/navigation modal with native Escape/focus, unload warning, scope cancellation and canonical account-menu return.
No backend, identity, Settings/Appearance, voice/check-in, registry, default gate or migration change.

verification.note: Before final CSS-only action wrapping and one added live-capability test. Final focused tests/hooks cover final code. Existing optional F07/F08 skips; actual pinned F22 export enabled.

verification.proof: Actual route handlers, temporary SQLite/secrets, five edits, multiline/clear, hidden answers/interview, restart, CAS conflict, idempotent lost-ack retry, atomic failure/retry, disabled provider. Script excludes inherited hook Git metadata during its pin checks.

verification.command: bunx prettier --check ui/src/brief/account/profile scripts/check-d29-f23.ts docs/brief-delivery/D-29.md docs/brief-delivery/D-29.json

commit_hooks.note: Normal license, migrations, templates, package, related tests and TypeScript. Initial integration pin check saw inherited Git hook metadata; corrected within proof script and normal hooks rerun. No bypass or coauthor trailers.

browser.final_css: Narrow action wrap and reserved Cancel/Reload width verified after rebuild at 320/390; earlier desktop matrix retained.

Production activation or real user data mutation

Whole repository suite locally; PR CI reported separately

rollback: Remove optional Profile registration or restore existing profile settings surface. Revert card commits; no migration or data rollback.
private_progress: Kept outside product repository; shared Drive roadmap unchanged.

Uncertain drafts remain editable and keep required reconciliation, including validation and return-to-base edits.
Stable textarea elements retain focus and selection when removing legacy newlines; 44px/96px geometry unchanged.
